parent.rule: Parent raw role must strictly equal 'SIMULATION' without strip or case normalization.

child.rule: Child raw role must strictly equal 'READ_ONLY' without strip or case normalization.

config_id_matching.rule: rawConfigId must equal original untrimmed descriptor expectedConfigId, and snapshot-supported trim(configId) must equal the SAME untrimmed descriptor expectedConfigId.

capability_boundary_matching.rule: raw config capabilityBoundary must match factory-cloned/trimmed descriptor expectedCapabilityBoundary case-insensitively BEFORE snapshot; raw capabilityBoundary is never stripped.

descriptor_formatting_preservation.rule: Original descriptor expectedRole and expectedCapabilityBoundary padding and lowercase are preserved verbatim in output bundle.

descriptor_sha256.rule: Descriptor expectedConfigSha256 must be strictly 64 ASCII hex characters without padding or trimming.

executable_sha256.rule: Executable SHA256 must be trimmed 64 ASCII hex characters.

path_equality.rule: Declared Windows path equality verified under DOS comparison domain (normcase(abspath(p)).rstrip('\/')).

path_ancestry_verification.rule: Direct nofollow lstat ancestry guard checks drive root (C:\) and every actual component with os.lstat without lexists/isdir/isfile error-masking; rejects reparse points (0x400) and symlinks; catches only FileNotFoundError for new output leaf.

read_once_provenance.rule: Common readonce helper captures prior lstat, handle fstat, raw bytes, and SHA-256 for spec and configs; linked into PROVENANCE_MANIFEST.json.

userdata_isolation.rule: workerUserDataDirectory and validatorUserDataDirectory must be distinct when normalized.

content_profile_fingerprint.rule: expectedContentProfileFingerprint must be a non-blank string (not constrained to 64 hex characters).

package_policy_declaration.rule: Object containing schemaVersion, policyId, revision, and admittedPackageIds; revision admits string or integer with explicit boolean exclusion; admittedPackageIds retains order.

timestamp_format.rule: issuedAtUtc must be a valid Gregorian UTC ISO 8601 string (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss[.1..7digits]Z) with ASCII digits [0-9], full consumption, calendar/time validity, and exact raw fractional digits preserved.

cli_invocation.rule: Strict --spec <absoluteSpecPath> CLI invocation with exact argc 3; closed 6 required keys + optional bundleFilename fixed to 'operator_startup_pair.json'. Inline mode rejected fail-closed.
